newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - SAUDI NEWSPAPERS - AUG 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - SAUDI NEWSPAPERS - AUG 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Total storage capacity of dams in Saudi Arabia will reach 1.3 billion cubic metres when current dam projects are completed.
- Some 25 shops in Madina were closed for breaking Saudisation rules.
- Around 600 foreigners who stayed in Saudi Arabia beyond the period permitted by their visas were deported from Jeddah port.
- Singapore Airlines will begin operations from Jeddah with an inaugural flight on Sunday.
- A new British-made mine sweeper will start sailing to the kingdom from Britain on Thursday.
- Around 30 restaurants were closed in Riyadh for violating health regulations, 290 restaurants were warned and fined.
- Chase Manhattan Bank leads a 1.6 billion riyal financing facility to National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia.
- Bosnia's deputy president says Saudi Arabia assistance helped unity and stability of Bosnia. Saudi has recently built 100 houses in Bosnia.
- Imports of frozen meat from Sudan are increasing.
